_meta.description: Firms appointed on Lines 4 and 4A. 'tender_ids' link to tenders.json.

contractors.name: Reliance Infrastructure and Astaldi (JV)
contractors.role: Civil contractor, three packages: Wadala to Amar Mahal Junction, Gandhi Nagar to Sonapur, Kapurbawdi to Kasarvadavali
contractors.notes: Fined Rs 5 crore after the Mulund parapet collapse of 14 Feb 2026. Free Press Journal reports that work on its Mulund stretch passed to a subcontractor in 2022 because of delays.

contractors.name: Tata Projects and China Harbour Engineering Company (JV)
contractors.role: Civil contractor, two packages: Garodia Nagar to Surya Nagar, Mulund Fire Station to Majiwada

contractors.name: J Kumar Infraprojects
contractors.role: Civil contractor, Line 4A, Kasarvadavali to Gaimukh

contractors.name: SEW Infrastructure and Vishwa Samudra Engineering (JV)
Larsen & Toubro
contractors.role: Integrated systems (trains, signalling, telecom, platform screen doors, depot machinery), track from Bhakti Park to Mulund Fire Station, and power supply from Wadala to Cadbury Junction

contractors.name: Alstom
contractors.role: Trains (39 Metropolis, six cars each), signalling and depot equipment, as L&T's partner, with five years of maintenance

contractors.name: Apurvakriti Infrastructure
contractors.role: Track, Mulund Fire Station to Gaimukh

contractors.name: Univastu India
contractors.role: E&M systems, as L&T's subcontractor on CA-298
contractors.notes: Rs 391.76 crore, per Metro Rail Today.

contractors.name: DB Engineering & Consulting, Louis Berger and Hill International (JV)
contractors.role: General consultant, Lines 4 and 4A, from 2017 until MMRDA ended its services on 18 Feb 2026

excluded_claims.claim: Station finishing CA-302 (tender 2026_MMRDA_1297164_1, 27 Apr 2026: finishing at 5 stations and steel roofs at 3) and CA-310 (tender 2026_MMRDA_1298434_1, about Rs 115.9 crore, with Sonapur, bids due 2 Jun 2026)
excluded_claims.reason: Seen only in search excerpts of tender aggregator pages (tenders.infralens.in, publicservicesmap.in) that could not be opened; the station names and results are not known.

excluded_claims.claim: Train housekeeping for 62 trains of Lines 4 and 4A and other lines (2026_MMRDA_1295762_1) and skilled staff for station maintenance on Lines 4 and 4A (2026_MMRDA_1298749_1), both 2026
excluded_claims.reason: Seen only in aggregator listings that could not be opened.

excluded_claims.claim: Finishing at 7 stations went to Eagle Infra (CA-194) and Godrej & Boyce (CA-222)
excluded_claims.reason: Both were lowest bidders in February 2024 at about 25% over MMRDA's estimate; no award, cancellation or new tender for them was found. CA-290 and the 2026 tenders may cover some of the same stations.
